claims.claim: Direct UK PS4 slim (i.e., genuine import from UK)
claims.evidence: No region/model sticker (CUH-XXXX) or UK plug/voltage marking visible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed from the image.
No screenshot of the system menu, firmware version, or game library is shown; a jailbreak state cannot be seen from an exterior photo.

claims.claim: Comes with two brand new pads
claims.evidence: Two boxed DualShock 4 controllers are visible (supports that two controllers are included), but the boxes alone do not prove they are unopened/unused rather than resealed or refurbished.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on to the home screen

risks.risk: Jailbreak/hack could be unstable, bricked, or illegal resale risk, and 'games installed' unverifiable
risks.proof: Screenshot of the system menu showing firmware version and installed game library
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a stock, unmodified console with no software value added

risks.proof: Screenshot of system storage settings or the rear label showing capacity
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest common PS4 Slim capacity (500GB)

risks.risk: Missing power cable/HDMI cable not shown
risks.proof: A photo showing all included cables laid out with the console
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console-only, no cables included

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear, scratches, or dents on unseen sides (back/underside)
risks.proof: Additional photos of the rear, underside, and ports
risks.if_unproven: Priced as heavily used/worst cosmetic condition

risks.risk: Controllers' actual condition (new vs opened/used) not confirmed
risks.proof: Photos of controller serial stickers and seal condition, or a working video
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used controllers, not new

risks.risk: Model/region (CUH number) unconfirmed, affecting compatibility and resale value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the barcode/model label on the console's underside

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen
Screenshot of system settings showing storage capacity and firmware version
Close-up photo of the model/serial label on the console's underside
Photo of all included cables (power cord, HDMI)
Photos of the console's back and underside for wear
Photos of controller serial numbers and box seals
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Sony PS4 Slim with two boxed DualShock 4 controllers, so it can be priced at worst case pending proof of working condition, hack status, storage, and accessory completeness.
